observation.visible_scene: An indoor room in which a red upholstered armchair/sofa on the left is fully engulfed in orange-yellow flames. In the foreground right, a small round table covered with a light cloth holds a remote control and a potted plant with dark red flowers; a wood-paneled wall and a curtain edge form the background.
visible_changes: The flames on the sofa flicker, rise, swirl, and change shape continuously throughout the excerpt, with bright yellow tongues dominating the left-center mass.

Fire activity on the right side of the sofa grows over the segment: early frames show only low, broken flames there, while later frames (from ~t=2.0 s) show tall flame columns rising behind and to the right of the potted plant.

The framing gradually widens/shifts (a slow zoom-out/pan is suggested), revealing more of the tablecloth and a second potted plant with white flowers entering the right edge of view from about t=2.0 s onward.
The table, remote, and both potted plants remain stationary and unburned in the foreground for the whole excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or onset of the fire is not shown; the excerpt begins mid-burn.
Whether the fire eventually reaches the table or plants, and the outcome after t=3.2 s, are not visible.
uncertain_details: Exact camera motion (zoom-out vs pan-right) cannot be fully confirmed from background evidence.
Right-side flame growth may partly reflect flicker rather than definite spread.
Little smoke is visible, so the true extent of combustion behind the flames is unknown.
